title: Day by day in the temple
author: Acts
lines: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple,
they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,
praising God, and having favor with all the people.
The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.
why: The first church in one sentence: Jews who believed in Jesus, still praying in the Temple every day, and sharing bread at home. Say it to remember that Christianity began inside Judaism, not against it.

title: God shows no favouritism
author: Acts
lines: Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;
but in every nation he who fears him
and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
why: Peter's words in the house of a Roman officer, the moment the door opened to the nations. Say them when you are tempted to think some people are beyond God's welcome.

title: The gifts and the calling of God
author: Romans
lines: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
why: Paul's last word on his own people: God does not take back his promises to Israel. Say it as a guard against every kind of contempt, and as a reason to trust that God keeps faith.
